pages.text:
Bess sat on the bus. She had
a big box. What was in the
box?

Bess did not tell Max and
Tiff. What was in the box?
The big box had a lid on top.
Bess had the box on her lap.

Huff! Puff! Yip! Yap!
What was in the box?
Bess did not tell Tiff yet.

Is it
a pup?
Yip, yap! Yip, yap! Bess did
not tell Max and Tiff. Is it a
pup?

The lid fell off! In the box
was Buzz. “Yes, it is a pup!”

Buzz was a hit! All of the kids
had fun.
